a_before_b.rationale: Defining full finetuning is not required to identify finetuning frameworks and tactics, as B covers a broad survey of tools and methods without needing deep knowledge of any single tactic.

b_before_a.rationale: Identifying finetuning frameworks and tactics is not required to define full finetuning, since the definition of full finetuning is self-contained and does not depend on knowing specific tools or other tactics.
